profile.headline: Sr. Data Analyst
profile.summary: Experienced Software Developer with a demonstrated history of working in financial services, medical and education industries. Strong business development professional skilled in Data Analytics and Visualizations utilizing Azure Databricks, Python, SAS, R and PowerBI.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.insights: SAS (Programming Language), Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) and +8 skills

positions.title: SAS Developer
positions.insights: SAS (Programming Language), Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) and +2 skills

positions.title: Program Specialist
positions.description:
•	Support the achievement of school district strategic objectives through the delivery of ad-hoc data analysis that provide timely and accurate information to school principals, superintendents, school board members and other administration staff utilizing SAS and SQL.
•	Improve reporting efficiency through the automation of recurring reports to support year over year analysis of key performance metrics  
•	Utilize Power Bi and Tableau to create interactive dashboards that allow decision makers to visualize data trends for easier analysis
•	Utilize various coding techniques to clean, validate and merge student data to create datasets for statistical analysis.
•	Create complex SQL queries to join multiple tables and convert data types for analysis.

positions.title: SAS Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Perform data distributions and analysis using various procedures such as PROC TABULATE, PROC FREQ, PROC MEANS, PROC SORT.
•	Process large raw data files as large as 300 million records in ASCII and EBCDIC formats.
•	Ability read/write data files in various formats such as fixed, variable block, and delimited.
•	Create CSV delimited files for multi-field pivot tables in excel.
•	Proficient in using mainframe SAS executed within JCL.
•	Active participation in process design whiteboard sessions to assess SAS program efficiencies and provide the necessary inputs on how to improve the standards.
•	Utilize various ODS such as TAGSETS.EXCELXP, HTML, RTF 
•	Utilize PROC REPORT and PROC PRINT to customize data reporting
•	Utilize SAS MACRO utility to 
•	Process multiple datasets for repetitive tasks reducing program code footprint.
•	Pass parameters that produce various reports based on multitier categories.
•	Invoke external SAS programs to retrieve data for use in main calling program.
•	Perform global program decisioning such as determining which data steps and PROCS to execute based on passed variables.

•	Utilize SAS/ACCESS to
•	 Retrieve data from Greenplum tables for processing in SAS programs.
•	Utilize PROC SQL to
•	Create, modify and join datasets
•	Create macro variables
•	PostgreSQL Development
•	Utilize PG Admin to create tables and/or views of data for SAS reports which may require multiple data types
•	Perl Scripting Development 
•	Lead white boarding/design sessions to identify potential project automation opportunities
•	Interface with multiple platforms and systems from mainframe to midrange 
•	Automate manual processes that query credit data and create SAS matrix reports
•	Update existing scripts to incorporate additional functionality such as ftp and email capabilities
